_README: FROZEN. Committed before any experimental data existed (CLAUDE.md §7).
Never modify this file. Never suggest modifying it after seeing results.
If a result is ambiguous the pre-specified response is ADD SEEDS, never
adjust a threshold. If this file contains a genuine specification error,
say so explicitly and stop -- do not fix it unilaterally.
Amendments, if ever unavoidable, go in a new file analysis_plan_v2.json
with its own timestamp, and both files are reported in the paper.

_note: The protocol states windows in 1-based task numbers. The code logs
task_idx 0-based, plus task_idx = -1 for the pre-training 'init' probe.
Both forms are given here so no analysis ever converts by hand.

definition: Per task, the fraction of training examples the network classified
correctly on the forward pass taken BEFORE the parameter update for that
minibatch, averaged over the task's single pass through the 60k images.
Measured on the training-mode forward pass, matching Dohare et al.'s
online measure. Consequence, stated in advance: for the dropout arm this
is measured under dropout, as it is in Dohare et al.
secondary_definition: Eval-mode top-1 accuracy on the fixed 2048-example held-out probe batch
under the current task's permutation, from the same forward pass as the
activation statistics. Reported alongside the primary; the dropout arm is
compared on this measure as well as the primary.

statistics.estimator_definition: interquartile mean; scipy.stats.trim_mean(x, 0.25), per Agarwal et al. 2021
statistics.stratification: resample runs (seeds) with replacement, independently within each task column
paired_rationale: Seed s of every arm starts from the identical initialisation and sees the
identical task stream, so arm comparisons resample the same seed indices
for both arms. Pairing removes initialisation variance that would

approx_equal.rule: 95% CI of the difference contains zero AND |delta| < 1.0 percentage points

much_greater.rule: delta > 2.0 percentage points AND 95% CI excludes zero

decision_thresholds.response_to_inconclusive: add seeds; never adjust a threshold

seeds._note: seeds are 0..n-1 and are shared across arms within an experiment

gate.criterion_verbatim: Mean per-task accuracy over tasks 151-200 must be >= 3 percentage points below tasks 1-10, with a stratified-bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero, and dead_exact must rise monotonically.

setup.width_rationale: width 500 rather than Dohare et al.'s 2000: they report plasticity loss is most pronounced at smaller widths (their Fig. 2b, middle panel)

_operationalisation_note: The protocol's phrase 'dead_exact must rise monotonically' is not
satisfiable as literal per-task monotonicity over 200 noisy
measurements. Operationalised here, before any data existed, as a
Spearman rank correlation -- which is itself a measure of monotonic
association and cannot be satisfied by a curve that rises then falls.
This operationalisation was chosen by the researcher on 2026-08-05 and
is frozen with the rest of this file.
dead_unit_criterion.probe_batch_rationale: matches Dohare et al., who compute dead units on the current task's distribution, keeping the number comparable to the Nature paper; the reference batch is logged and reported alongside but is not the gate criterion
dead_unit_criterion.layer_scope_definition: dead units summed over all three hidden layers divided by 1500, giving one value per (seed, task)
dead_unit_criterion.statistic: Spearman rank correlation between task_idx and the pooled dead_exact fraction, computed per seed over the trend window, then IQM across seeds

order: raise the learning rate (Dohare's largest step size shows the strongest effect)

dissociation_stop_rule.action: STOP and report. That dissociation is itself a result and changes the paper. Do not proceed to §B.1 without an explicit decision.

primary_experiment.name: ReDo tau-sweep with size-matched random control
primary_experiment.cardinality_rule: k = |tau-dormant set|, recomputed at every event, per layer; identical across redo, random_matched and inverse_matched at a given tau, seed and event
primary_experiment.headline_figure: tau on the x-axis; final accuracy and the truly-dead fraction of the recycled set on twin y-axes

headline_quantities.final_accuracy: IQM of online_accuracy over the late window
headline_quantities.truly_dead_fraction: n_dead_exact / k, pooled over layers and events within a run, measured on the current-task probe batch

planned_comparisons.test: paired stratified bootstrap of the IQM difference in late-window online_accuracy
paired stratified bootstrap of the IQM difference in late-window online_accuracy
paired stratified bootstrap of the IQM difference in late-window online_accuracy

predictions.if: accuracy improves with tau while the truly-dead fraction of the recycled set falls
predictions.then: C1 confirmed: ReDo is not a resurrection method

predictions.if: redo ≈ random_matched at large tau (by the approx_equal rule above)
predictions.then: targeting is irrelevant; only perturbation dose matters. Strongest form of C1

predictions.if: redo ≫ random_matched at every tau (by the much_greater rule above)
predictions.then: C1 refuted. Targeting does matter -- report it honestly; the measurement work (C2, C3) still stands
sanity check passed, replicating Sokar et al. Fig. 15

c3_anomaly.arms_not_yet_implemented_note: Online Normalization (Chiley et al. 2019) is deliberately unimplemented in src/models.py rather than approximated; it must be implemented faithfully before this arm is run
target_observations: L2 improves final accuracy WHILE increasing dead_exact and decreasing effective rank
online norm has MORE dead units than plain backprop in later tasks despite being designed to prevent them
c3_anomaly.decomposition: for any confirmed anomaly, decompose with C2: exactly-zero units (dead_exact) versus merely low-magnitude ones (dead_absolute at each threshold)

c5_optimizer.target_observation: a per-neuron death spike in the first steps after each task switch, when m-hat has updated but v-hat has not (Lyle et al. Fig. 1 mechanism)
c5_optimizer.adamw_question: does decoupled weight decay make revival of an already-dead unit more likely, giving a NON-MONOTONIC relationship between weight-decay strength and dead fraction?

eps_sweep._source: protocol §B.4, demoted to a replication arm
eps_sweep.purpose: dose-response replication in continual supervised learning, filling the gap between Sokar et al. (RL, single eps) and Dohare et al. (six activations, toy regression)
eps_sweep.status: optional; cut if Week 2 runs long

metric_definitions_note: The four death definitions, effective rank, sign entropy and the Sokar
score are implemented in src/probes.py and are not restated here, so there
is exactly one definition of each. dormant_tau's blind spot to uniform
layer shrinkage is intentional and is the subject of C2; it must not be

compute_budget.buffer_policy: do not spend the buffer early; runs will be lost to bugs
